findings.title: str-enum Role comparison is alphabetical, not by rank
findings.explanation: Role subclasses str, so Role(...) < minimum compares the string values: 'viewer' < 'admin' and 'billing' < 'admin' are False, so viewers and billing users pass admin checks (void, refund), while 'admin' < 'billing' is True, so admins are refused billing actions. Compare explicit ranks.

findings.title: find_by_number is not tenant-scoped
findings.explanation: The refactor replaced the tenant filter with a raw query on number alone. Invoice numbers are per-tenant (INV-00001 exists in every tenant), so GET /invoices/by-number/<n> returns another tenant's invoice. Use self._one(ctx, 'number = ?', (number,)).

findings.title: Invoice cache bypasses tenant scoping
findings.explanation: The cache key is the invoice id only and the cached object is returned before the scoped repository query, so once tenant A has read invoice 5, tenant B's GET /invoices/5 (or pay) gets it too. The PR also deleted the test asserting that 404. Key by tenant and check invoice.tenant_id against ctx.

findings.title: New idempotency key per retry causes double charges
findings.explanation: README: the key never changes and the gateway is idempotent per key. A timeout may mean the charge went through ('lost'); retrying with a fresh key charges the customer again. The payment row also keeps payment-<id>, so the webhook for the retried charge no longer matches. Always reuse payment.idempotency_key.

findings.title: Unsigned webhooks are accepted
findings.explanation: When X-Signature is missing signature_ok returns True, so anyone can POST an unsigned payment.succeeded event with a guessable key (payment-<id>) and mark invoices paid. README requires 401 for any request without a valid signature.

findings.title: Timed-out refunds are completed without confirmation
findings.explanation: On GatewayTimeout the refund is marked succeeded and unapplied from the invoice although the gateway may never have processed it. README: a refund succeeds only once confirmed and a timed-out refund stays pending; a later refund.failed webhook is now ignored because the status is no longer pending.

findings.title: Migration silently drops account credits
findings.explanation: The backfill uses an inner JOIN on invoices, so payments with invoice_id NULL (account credits, migration 0003) are not copied into payments_new and are lost when the old table is dropped. Take the tenant from customers instead.

findings.title: convert truncates instead of rounding half-even
findings.explanation: int() truncates toward zero; README requires ROUND_HALF_EVEN. 10.00 USD at 0.9217 gives 921 cents instead of 922, so foreign-currency lines are under-billed.

findings.title: Staff check is always true
findings.explanation: is_staff is an INTEGER 0/1, never None, so `user.is_staff is not None` holds for every user: any API key can send X-Tenant-Id and read or modify any tenant. README requires 403 for non-staff. Use `if acting_as is not None: if not user.is_staff: raise Forbidden`.
